info.name: EMS API
info.description:
Postman collection for the EMS Appointment & Test Drive API (Wallan Group · AI Project).

Base URL: https://ems.wallan.com/api/v1
Auth: api_key sent in the POST body (recommended) or as a ?api_key= URL parameter.

Synced with https://ems.wallan.com/api/v1/appointment/Documentation.php (21 endpoints, official page Last updated: July 26, 2026 · v1.3.0).
Live test-drive APIs re-checked: August 15, 2026.

CHANGES IN THIS REVISION (Aug 15, 2026 — live TD APIs)
• 17. TD Slots: available_slots is now an array of objects (not time strings). Each object has time_hhmm, duration_min, available. Unavailable slots include reason (CAPACITY_REACHED | SLOT_TAKEN) and appointment_id/app_id when SLOT_TAKEN. Duplicate key "slots" mirrors available_slots.
• 17. TD Slots: response also includes is_holiday, holiday_name, is_dayoff, capacity, booked, total_slots, car, car_model.
• Refreshed live samples for TD brands/cities/showrooms/cars/slots/lookup/get.

PRIOR (Aug 9, 2026)
• 10. Book Appointment: optional schedule; already_booked documented
• 11. Cancel Appointment: already_cancelled documented
• 06 / 19: service vs test-drive lookup titles
• 18. TD Book: showroom_not_found and showroom/car validation 400s

Final step to submit a booking.

Business rules:
• The provided sa_id is preserved for advisor attribution.
• If rating is less than 5 you MUST provide a valid reason.
• schedule: 1 = Rescheduled, 0 = Not rescheduled (default 0).
• Duplicate active booking: returns already_booked with existing appointment details (do not create a second active service booking).
• All responses include outbound status flags: booking_confirmed, booking_rescheduled, booking_cancelled, call_status.
• All API bookings are tagged with source 'AI Project' (ID 16).

request.description: Retrieves all brands available for test drives.
Retrieves cities configured for a specific brand.
Retrieves showrooms available in a specific city.

Retrieves cars and location booking types (showroom / home) for the brand + showroom.

Renault per-car location rules:
• Models containing '/ Showroom' → restricted to ["showroom"] only.
• Models containing '/ Home' → restricted to ["home"] only.
• Models with neither suffix → support both ["showroom", "home"].
• All other brands → return ["showroom"] only.

query.description: Yes | Vehicle model name (aliases: car, model_code).

request.description:
Retrieves all test drive time slots for a showroom, vehicle and date.

CHANGED (live API, Aug 2026): available_slots is no longer a simple array of time strings.

Each item is an object:
• time_hhmm — 24-hour time (e.g. "09:00")
• duration_min — slot length in minutes (typically 60)
• available — true if the slot can be booked
• reason — only when available=false: CAPACITY_REACHED or SLOT_TAKEN
• appointment_id / app_id — only when reason=SLOT_TAKEN

A duplicate "slots" array mirrors available_slots.

Also returns: is_holiday, holiday_name, is_dayoff, capacity, booked, total_slots, car, car_model.

Request params unchanged: showroom_id + car_model + date required; brand_id optional (default 1 / Hyundai).

request.description:
Final step to submit a test drive booking.

Business rules:
• location_type=home is ONLY allowed for the Renault brand; using it for another brand returns 400.
• Duplicate rejection: returns 409 Conflict with error_code 'already_booked' plus existing_appointment_id if the phone number already has an active upcoming booking.
• Slot unavailable: returns 409 Conflict with error_code 'slot_unavailable' if the slot is already reserved.
• Showroom validation: returns 400 Bad Request with error_code 'showroom_not_found' if the showroom ID does not exist.
• Showroom/car validation: returns 400 if the selected car is not available for that showroom.

call_status values:
• 'contacted' — booking/request completed successfully, or the customer was reached.
• 'not_contacted' — pending call schedule / customer not yet contacted.
• 'failed' — any failure, error or unsuccessful operation.

request.description:
Test Drive Lookup API (for test drive bookings). Looks up upcoming active test drives for a customer by phone number.

Returns all appointments for the phone number, sorted newest to oldest (ORDER BY date DESC). Each appointment includes a detailed last_status object and status flags representing one of 3 states:

1. Booked (pending): status='Booked', booking_confirmed=true, booking_cancelled=false, call_status='not_contacted'.
2. Conducted (completed): status='Conducted', booking_confirmed=true, booking_cancelled=false, call_status='contacted'.
3. Cancelled: status='Cancelled', booking_confirmed=false, booking_cancelled=true, call_status='cancelled'.

Live responses may include many historical appointments (count can be > displayed examples).
NEW ENDPOINT. Retrieves full details of a specific test drive booking by appointment ID.
